title: Fable shows a full quest in new gameplay ⚔️
subject: fable
description:
Are you playing Fable on PS5, Xbox or PC? 👇

Playground Games released Official Quest Gameplay for Fable on November 12, 2026 at Xbox's 25th anniversary FanFest, showing the Hero and Arden in Deepwood. Fable launches February 23, 2027 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC.

Sources: Xbox Wire 25th anniversary recap (Nov 12, 2026), Final Weapon (Nov 12, 2026), VGC, GamesRadar+

scenes.text: Fable just played out a full quest.
Playground Games showed the new gameplay on November 12, at Xbox's 25th anniversary FanFest.
Your Hero and a character named Arden head into Deepwood, chasing corrupted magic in Oakshire.
Fights mix swords and spells, and the Steam page lists Hobbes, Balverines and Trolls among the enemies.
Hayley Atwell voices the villain, Isabel.
Fable launches February 23, 2027, on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC.
